facts.fact: N'Djamena Actu reports that the Chad Police Information System (SIPT) project is financed by the European Union, as stated at its third steering committee on 3 July 2025.
N'Djamena Actu reports that the SIPT project is implemented by INTERPOL, whose Secretary General asked authorities for full ownership of the system by the security forces.

systems.system: Systeme d'Information Policiere du Tchad (SIPT) / CREDOP
systems.owner: INTERPOL implementing, Ministry of Public Security

TCD.note: The source names a data centre, AFIS and an I-24/7 channel but does not say stations record reports in the system.
The document concerns the police information system and states nothing on secondary schools.
